errors.bad_agent: agent is required and may hold only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'
errors.bad_sid: sid is required and may hold only letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'
errors.no_transcript: this agent has no earlier runs or messages on this task
errors.run_key_only: session snapshots move only with the key of the run they belong to
errors.run_session_scope: a run reaches only its own agent's session and transcript, on its own task
errors.runs_read_required: the transcript is built from run logs: the key needs runs:read
errors.snapshot_too_large: the session snapshot is over {max} bytes; the next resume starts from the transcript

log.remove_task_sessions: remove the session snapshots of task {task}
